name: context-bar
description: Live, colour-segmented context window bar above the prompt, split into ACTIVE and PASSIVE halves with an auto-compact marker.

legend.title: Show legend
legend.description: Show the per-category legend under the bar.

warnAtHalf.title: Warn at 50%
warnAtHalf.description: Toast once per session when the context window passes 50%.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: When to pin 'ctx 71%' under the prompt: auto (band hidden or a surface without the band), always, or off.
